gwt.given: an ISiloBuilder whose configuration has an "OrleansData" section with DatabaseKey "Common", and Orleans passes the provider's own configuration section (Orleans:GrainStorage:catalog) which either sets DatabaseKey "Catalog" or omits DatabaseKey
gwt.when: ArgentSeaGrainStorageDbProviderBuilder.Configure is invoked on that builder with provider name "catalog" and that configuration section
gwt.then: ArgentSeaGrainStorageFactory.CreateDb is registered under "catalog" against the silo's service collection, and the named OrleansDbPersistenceOptions for "catalog" get DatabaseKey "Catalog" when the provider section sets it, otherwise "Common" from OrleansData; if OrleansData also lacks DatabaseKey the value is "Default", and if the provider section lacks the key and no OrleansData section exists Configure throws InvalidOperationException
